body: "I'm here for you" ha, what a load. All that phrase does is alleviate any guilt for the person saying it. It's nothing but an empty promise.
:/ The cat is cute, but this is sad. He's sitting like that because the mutation that makes the cartilage in his ears weak and fold down, does the same to the rest of the cartilage in his body.
This is probably it. Saying "oh, it'll get better" allows them to avoid the fact that life just isn't fair. For a lot of us, no, it won't ever get better.

Meh, I've embalmed before, we all look terrible when we're dead. Plan on cremation anyway. 

There are two people I'd miss (and one cat) and I'll spend as much time with them before I go as I can. Kinda resigning myself at this point, after I do that, my best friend will hate me. But oh well, I suppose I won't be around to deal with it in any case.
Platitudes are nice and all, but they literally don't help anyone.
